newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Howard Smith confirms A$1.2 bln debt plan.
newsitem.headline: Howard Smith confirms A$1.2 bln debt plan.

text.p: Hardware, engineering and towage group Howard Smith Ltd confirmed on Wednesday newspaper and magazine reports that it planned a bank debt refinancing and corporate bond issue totalling A$1.2 billion.
"We hope to have it all stitched up early in the new financial year," said Howard Smith General Manager of Finance Graham Watson.

Watson told Reuters he could confirm an Australian Financial Review report, based on financing magazine report, that Howard Smith had appointed Bankers Trust Australia to advise on the re-financing of its A$915 million of core debt.

Watson said he could not confirm how much of the A$1.2 billion debt deal would be made up of corporate bond issuance, although the Financial Review said Howard Smith was considering a A$300 million issue.
Watson also could not say how much of the A$1.2 billion would be re-financing and how much would be new debt.
Howard Smith has said it is eyeing acquisition opportunities worth up to A$500 million in Australia and offshore.
